title: Hezekiah's Prayer and Sennacherib's Defeat
description:
When the Assyrian king Sennacherib threatens Jerusalem, King Hezekiah tears his clothes, puts on sackcloth, and goes into the house of the Lord.  
He sends word to the prophet Isaiah, who answers that the Lord will make Sennacherib return to his own land and fall by the sword there.  
Sennacherib sends a mocking letter to Hezekiah, who spreads it out before the face of the Lord and prays for deliverance, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that the Lord alone is God.  
Isaiah brings the Lord's answer: Sennacherib will not enter the city, and a remnant will go out from Jerusalem.  
The angel of the Lord strikes down 185,000 in the Assyrian camp, and Sennacherib returns to Nineveh, where he is killed by his own sons Adrammelech and Sharezer while worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch.
